entry.subject: tdec_initiation_urgency
entry.content: With a 2026-10-12 on-site start and TDEC requiring 4–6 weeks from first contact, the TDEC process must be initiated by approximately 2026-09-01 at the latest; no evidence of TDEC contact exists yet, making this immediately actionable.
entry.falsification_test: Evidence that TDEC has already been contacted or that the property is confirmed on city sewer would falsify this.
